title: Reasoning Jury: Multi-Model Consensus for Evaluating Reasoning Traces
abstract: arXiv:2608.12585v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Improving reasoning LLMs requires the ability to judge the quality of long reasoning traces for effective reasoning data curation, strong training signals during reinforcement learning, and an in-depth understanding of reasoning behaviors during model performance evaluation. Additionally, surfacing reasoning mistakes that the model makes would enable improving the model's performance at runtime through providing feedback. Due to the difficulty of this complex task on long reasoning traces, single-model judges (even frontier models) do not do well at identifying reasoning defects. Additionally, leveraging frontier models during online training of reasoning LLMs is generally prohibited due to guardrails in terms of use. In this work, we introduce Reasoning Jury, a system that replaces the single judge with a jury of LLMs and a moderated consensus mechanism, to improve the fidelity of judgments for identifying reasoning defects. translated_title: 推理陪审团：用于评估推理轨迹的多模型共识机制
translated_abstract: 提升推理型大语言模型（LLMs）需要能够评判长推理轨迹质量的能力，这有助于有效的推理数据整理、强化学习中的强训练信号，以及模型性能评估中对推理行为的深入理解。此外，揭示模型所犯的推理错误，可通过提供反馈在运行时改进模型性能。由于长推理轨迹上这一复杂任务的难度，单一模型评判者（即使是前沿模型）在识别推理缺陷方面表现不佳。同时，在推理LLMs的在线训练中，通常因使用限制的护栏而禁止利用前沿模型。在本工作中，我们引入了推理陪审团（Reasoning Jury），该系统用一组LLM陪审团和调节共识机制替代单一评判者，以提高识别推理缺陷的评判保真度。在推理测试中，该系统的性能显著优于单一评判者。
tldr: 本文提出“推理陪审团”系统，通过多LLM共识机制替代单一评判者，显著提升长推理轨迹中推理缺陷识别的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "Reasoning Jury," a system that replaces a single judge with a multi-LLM consensus mechanism, significantly improving the accuracy of identifying reasoning defects in long reasoning traces.
